identification: Twin-cylinder opposed petrol (gas) model aircraft engine with Walbro-type carburettor, two aluminium canister mufflers, fuel tank; no maker seen, likely Chinese DLE-type 50-60cc class. Box also has a small red bench vice, files, Workzone spring set, Maden China TY-1 M3-M12 thread gauge set (low value).
searches_tried: pipeline/comps.py: 'model aircraft engine', 'twin cylinder petrol engine', 'DLE engine', 'Walbro carburettor', 'model plane engine', 'thread gauge', 'bench vice'; work/comps.py: 'model engine petrol', 'aircraft engine'. No same-item hits. Only unrelated hits (Noble trench art, Leski die-cast display plane). Bench vice hits are Armitage paid-locally only (small vice $20-$120 local; eBay small vice about $29-$53), not recorded as entries since the vice is a minor part.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'DLE 55 twin gas engine', 'DLE 60 twin', 'DLE 35RA', 'twin cylinder petrol model aircraft engine', 'Evolution 50GX twin', 'Zenoah twin 50cc', 'RCGF 60 twin', each with Sold items filter, AU and 12 months; note whether sold with ignition module/CDI, mounting and muffler. Also search 'used gas RC engine twin' on Gumtree and eBay AU BIN for asking prices, and new retail of DLE 55 / DLE 60 (Hobbyking, RC Hobby Australia, Hobbies Australia) as ASKING new retail.
viewing_check: Look for maker/model stamp on crankcase or cylinder head (DLE, Evolution, Zenoah, RCGF, Saito), CDI ignition module and sensor/magnet presence on the rear, spark plugs, prop washer/drive hub, mounting bracket, compression feel (turn over by hand), corrosion or cracked fins, whether both mufflers and tank fit. Photograph engine ID marks and rear ignition area.
